findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Subsemiring/Basic.lean:746 `def restrict (f : R →+* S) (s' : σR) (s : σS) (h : ∀ x ∈ s', f x ∈ s) : s' →+* s := (f.domRestrict s').codRestrict s fun x => h x x.2`; line 750 `@[simp] theorem coe_restrict_apply ... = f x := rfl`.
findings.fix: Define `kostantFormMap f e h := (map ℚ f).toRingHom.restrict (kostantForm e h) (kostantForm (fun i => f (e i)) (fun i => f (h i))) (fun x hx => by rw [← map_kostantForm f e h]; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)`; the coe lemma then closes by `rfl` (or is subsumed by the existing `@[simp] RingHom.coe_restrict_apply`).
findings.issue: `kostantFormMap` hand-assembles `((map ℚ f).toRingHom.comp (kostantForm e h).subtype).codRestrict _ _`, which is verbatim the body of Mathlib's `RingHom.restrict`. `coe_kostantFormMap_apply` (line 212) then restates `RingHom.coe_restrict_apply`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Subring/Basic.lean:975 `def subringMap (e : R ≃+* S) : s ≃+* s.map e.toRingHom`; coe lemma at Subsemiring/Basic.lean:890. TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/UniversalEnveloping/Functoriality.lean:165 `def mapEquiv (e : LieEquiv R L M) : … ≃ₐ[R] …`, with the same inverse argument at lines 176-180, and `mapEquiv_toAlgHom` at line 185.
findings.fix: Use `((mapEquiv ℚ g).toRingEquiv.subringMap (s := kostantForm e h)).trans (RingEquiv.subringCongr h')`, identifying `((mapEquiv ℚ g).toRingEquiv : _ →+* _)` with `(map ℚ g.toLieHom).toRingHom` via `mapEquiv_toAlgHom` to get `h'` from `map_kostantForm`. `coe_kostantFormEquiv_apply` then follows from `RingEquiv.subsemiringMap_apply_coe`.
findings.issue: `kostantFormEquiv` re-derives an equivalence from `Subring.equivMapOfInjective` plus an inlined injectivity proof (`map_injective_of_leftInverse` with a hand `LieHom.ext`/`symm_apply_apply` argument). Mathlib already packages exactly this as `RingEquiv.subringMap`, and this PR's stated dependency `mapEquiv` — which contains that same `LieHom.ext`/`symm_apply_apply` step — is not used anywhere in the file.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:643 `theorem range_comp' (g : α → β) (f : ι → α) : range (fun x => g (f x)) = g '' range f`; mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:533 `lemma map_choose`; TauCeti/RingTheory/DividedPowers/Associative.lean:90 `@[simp] theorem map_dividedPower`.
findings.fix: `rw [kostantRootGenerators, ← Set.range_comp']; exact congrArg Set.range (funext fun p => by simp)` and likewise `rw [kostantCartanGenerators, ← Set.range_comp']; exact congrArg Set.range (funext fun p => by simp [Ring.map_choose])`.
findings.issue: `image_kostantRootGenerators` and `image_kostantCartanGenerators` (line 174) prove `f '' range g = range (f ∘ g)` by hand `ext`/`rintro` bashes; this is `Set.range_comp'`. The only non-plumbing content is the pointwise step, already available as `Associative.map_dividedPower` and `Ring.map_choose`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:646 `theorem range_subset_iff : range f ⊆ s ↔ ∀ y, f y ∈ s`; `Set.union_subset_iff` in Mathlib/Order/SetNotation and Data/Set/Basic; the generator sets are `Set.range` by their definitions at lines 73 and 80.
findings.fix: Replace the body with `simp [kostantForm, kostantGenerators, kostantRootGenerators, kostantCartanGenerators, Subring.closure_le, Set.union_subset_iff, Set.range_subset_iff, Prod.forall]`.
findings.issue: After `Subring.closure_le`, the ten-line proof of `kostantForm_le_iff` re-derives `Set.union_subset_iff`, `Set.range_subset_iff` and `Prod.forall` by hand `rintro`/`obtain` on the two ranges.

summary: The Kostant form itself is new material with no Mathlib or TauCeti counterpart, but four pieces of surrounding scaffolding re-derive located library API: RingHom.restrict, RingEquiv.subringMap (plus TauCeti's own mapEquiv), Set.range_comp', and Set.range_subset_iff/union_subset_iff.
